notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.effective_date: taxable years of organizations described in section 1381(a) of this title beginning after Dec.
notes.text: Repeal applicable, except as otherwise provided, to taxable years of organizations described in section 1381(a) of this title beginning after Dec. 31, 1962, see section 17(c) of Pub. L. 87–834, set out as an Effective Date note under section 1381 of this title.
